content.text:
The new file `src/lib/ui.ts` contains only two hard-coded string literals ("Cambiar el tema" / "Toggle the theme") in a typed `Record<Lang, ...>` map. There are:

- No entry points (no HTTP handler, IPC, CLI, webhook).
- No sinks (no shell/exec, SQL, filesystem, HTML sink, template, SSRF, deserializer, log, etc.).
- No attacker-influenceable data — the values are compile-time constants and the only external symbol is a type-only import.
- No auth/permission surface, no parser, no registry that other security controls key off of.

Consumers rendering `ui[lang].themeToggle` receive a static author-controlled string; even in a raw HTML sink there is nothing an attacker can influence.
